title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool

sources.summary: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts

sources.summary: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life

sources.summary: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago

sources.summary: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips

sources.summary: After drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, the Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent.

title: AI assistant startup Town nabs unicorn valuation 4 months after launch

sources.summary: AI assistant startup Town nabbed a unicorn valuation on Monday, announcing a $108 million Series B round co-led by Forerunner Ventures and Menlo Ventures.

title: Rivian’s CEO says autonomy will enable ‘dramatically different’ vehicle designs

sources.summary: Founder and CEO RJ Scaringe said he thinks autonomy will allow his company to build radically different kinds of vehicles than the outdoorsy SUVs and trucks it currently makes.

title: Amazon to fund 12 small nuclear reactors at former Indiana coal plant

sources.summary: Amazon and X-energy have inked another deal to deploy nuclear power to the grid. This one will generate nearly 1 gigawatt of electricity.

title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again

sources.summary: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.

title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs

sources.summary: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.

title: Apple updates guidelines to ban nudify apps masquerading as regular apps to pass review

sources.summary: The company updated its guidelines with strong language around AI and user-generated content, and how app developers should include enough preventative measures to moderate objectionable or offensive content.

title: Musk pledges to give ‘every kid in America’ one of his SpaceX shares

sources.summary: Musk's post came just a few hours after Anthropic promised to put 5% of its shares into a new "public benefit fund," which it intends to use to make "large donations to traditional nonprofits or direct distributions to specific populations" after its upcoming IPO.

title: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they hit the real world

sources.summary: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup is competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt, October 13-15 in San Francisco.
